Title: Trivia Millionaire
Description: Trivia Millionaire is a trivia game where players answer questions by choosing the correct option from four possible answers. As they progress, they move through increasingly difficult levels that test their knowledge, focus, and ability to think quickly. The game covers a wide range of topics, offering a broad and engaging quiz experience. In addition to solo play, it also features a competitive mode where players can face each other in head-to-head trivia matches. At its core, the gameplay is built around rising difficulty, score progression, and constant knowledge challenges across different categories.
Instructions: Answer questions by selecting the one correct option out of four choices. Each correct answer earns rewards and moves you further through the difficulty curve. If a question feels too challenging, you can use hints to improve your chances. The farther you progress, the harder the questions become, and each mistake matters more. Successful runs earn in-game currency and leaderboard points. Score as high as you can, climb the rankings, and compete for a spot among the top trivia players.

Title: Flag Learn
Description:
Flag Learn is a geography quiz game that helps you truly memorize every flag,
capital, and US state — not just guess them. A smart spaced-repetition system
tracks each flag you've seen and brings back the ones you struggle with until
you master them all. Beyond the learning mode, you'll find a whole collection
of challenges: Daily Flagle, Paint the Flag, Border Guess, timed Highscore speedruns with a global leaderboard,
and real-time PvP battles against friends. Clean night-sky design, satisfying
progress tracking, and quick rounds make it perfect for both short sessions
and serious learning.
Instructions:
Learn and master all world flags, US states, and capitals. A flag appears —
type its name and confirm. Answer correctly 3 times in a row to master a flag
and add it to your collection. Mistakes cost a life; lives refill over time or
by watching a short ad. Master the full collection to become a true Flag
Master!

Try the Challenges: guess the daily flag in Daily Flagle, identify blurred
flags in Blur Mode, color flags in Paint the Flag, recognize countries by
their outline in Border Guess, race the clock in Highscore speedruns, or
battle friends in real-time PvP.

Desktop Controls:
Keyboard: Type the country, state, or capital name.
Enter: Submit your answer.
Mouse: Navigate menus, select modes, and pick colors in Paint the Flag.

Mobile Controls:
Tap: Navigate menus and select answers.
On-Screen Keyboard: Type your answer, then tap Check.
